title: Polly gets better at Discord formatting
summary:
Polly learned to handle tables and equations, four community apps joined the showcase, and video generation got clearer errors.

Community contributor YoannDev90 added support for rendering Markdown tables and LaTeX as images in Polly’s Discord replies. Long fenced code blocks can also be split without breaking lines. Tables and LaTeX fall back to text when the optional rendering dependencies are unavailable.

The catalog added idol-interaction, PolliGPT, Hyggshi OS Web Edition, and Viatosis, spanning games, chat, a web-based OS, and medical learning. The README showcase and Recent Apps section were also refreshed, including corrected attribution for PolliGPT.

Seedance, Wan, and xAI video generation now distinguish more input, content-policy, rate-limit, and upstream failures instead of returning generic server errors. Seedance 2.0 also checks supported aspect ratios before sending a request and stops polling predictions that have aborted or timed out.
